label: UIP-12 renames USD0++ to bUSD0 and adds the rt-bUSD0 early-exit right
note: Usual's roadmap dates UIP-12 to December 8, 2025. Legacy USD0++ positions became bUSD0; par exit before the June 11, 2028 maturity now needs one bUSD0 plus one rt-bUSD0, replacing the USUAL burning redemption (Usual bUSD0 fact sheet).

label: Usual Zero Rate market opens on Fira; Stability Loan migrates from Euler
note: Usual's roadmap lists UIP-18 ('UZR lending market launched') under January 8, 2026; Fira's blog dates UZR's opening with a first liquidity tranche to January 14, the date used here. UZR scaled from January 19 and gained a Borrow/Repay UI on January 22. Migration of bUSD0-collateralized Usual Stability Loan positions is one-way, Euler to Fira; USL USUAL rewards ended January 19 and UZR positions earn no USUAL emissions. Earlier label wrongly dated the USD0++ rename here; that was UIP-12 (2025-12-08).
